members.name: countdown
members.type: { to: Date | string | number; label?: string }
members.doc: Counts down to a moment, for example the end of a sale.

types.name: AnnouncementBarProps
types.doc: A slim bar for the top of a page. It can rotate several messages, each rising in from below while the bar springs to the new height; rotation pauses on hover, focus, or a hidden tab, and `controls` adds previous, next, and a pause ring. Messages can carry a call to action and a live countdown. Dismissing collapses the height smoothly so the page below eases up, and with an `id` the dismissal is remembered in `localStorage`.

members.name: id
members.doc: Remembers dismissal under this id. Change the id to show a new campaign to everyone again.

members.name: open
members.doc: Whether the bar is shown. Leave it out to let the component manage it.

members.name: interval
members.doc: Milliseconds each message stays before the next one. Defaults to 6000.

members.name: autoPlay
members.doc: Rotate automatically. Pauses on hover, focus, or a hidden tab, and is turned off when the visitor prefers reduced motion. Defaults to true.

members.name: controls
members.doc: Show previous, next, and pause controls when there are several messages. Defaults to false: only the close button shows.
